messages:
marta: Heads-up  found an inconsistency in the embeddings API reference. The page shows the request body using top-level "inputs" (plural) for batch requests, but the runtime accepts "input" (singular) for both single string and array payloads. This confused a customer who sent "inputs" and got a 400.

marta: Docs currently:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-large",
  "inputs": ["a", "b"]
}
```

marta: Actual accepted shape:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-large",
  "input": ["a", "b"]
}
```

oliver: Ah yeah, we normalized to "input" to match other endpoints. Docs should show the singular key and mention we accept either form for now. Can you open a PR?

marta: Opened tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12899. I changed examples (curl/Python/Node) to use "input" and added a migration note: "The embeddings API expects "input"; we accept "inputs" as an alias during the transition."

docs-bot: docs lint flagged one snippet: python example used client.embeddings.create(inputs=...) which should be client.embeddings.create(input=...). (file: api/embeddings.md line 56)

marta: Fixing that now and adding a defensive example for SDK callers:```python
# defensive helper for older scripts
params = {"model": "redwood-embed-large"}
if isinstance(user_input, list):
    params["input"] = user_input
else:
    params["input"] = [user_input]
resp = client.embeddings.create(**params)
```

support: Can we add a short changelog entry and ping Support? A few customers used the old "inputs" field in scheduled jobs.

oliver: Yes, add a changelog note and ping customers who hit 400s yesterday (I made a tiny query to find them). Also add a docs/spec test that looks for ""input"" in examples to prevent regression.

docs-bot: CI docs build 7005 for branch fix/embeddings-input-key (staging: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/api/embeddings).

marta: Preview looks good. Merging after CI green and test added. Thanks!
